regionPartition.description: Six non-overlapping half-open map/chunk regions cover [0,1664)×[0,928). A fragment has one homeRegion/chunkId, but sourceRect and ownershipRuns may cross region guides. Region guides MUST NOT clip alpha-connected ownership.

visualStructureExplanation.west-upper: Northwest lanterns, railing, carved pillar, wall panel and braces. The large west wall-panel owner crosses y=580 intact.
visualStructureExplanation.west-lower: Southwest wall-panel assembly, two independent illuminated lanterns, long-table frame, lower railings and one narrow brace. Every owner is one 8-connected component.
visualStructureExplanation.center: Sparse north-center area containing one visible wall sconce at (1112,230,18×54); it is explicitly not a pillar.
visualStructureExplanation.entrance: South-center entrance lantern posts and two hanging red banners.
visualStructureExplanation.east-upper: Northeast scroll-table front, upper/lower wall panels, carved pillars and narrow brace. The pillar at (1202,478,50×225) crosses y=580 intact.
visualStructureExplanation.east-lower: Southeast diagonal work support, worktable, fabric rack, railing post and low lantern. The diagonal support and worktable spanning y=580 remain single semantic owners.

outputConstraints.paddingPolicy: sourceRect may overlap and include transparent or non-owner pixels; E9B clears every pixel not listed in ownershipRuns
outputConstraints.reconstructionRequirement: copy owned canonical RGBA at identical destination coordinates; no scaling, resampling, color conversion, or duplicate composition
outputConstraints.includePolicy: every canonical pixel with alpha >= 1 is listed in exactly one ownershipRuns entry
outputConstraints.excludePolicy: ownershipRuns must never contain canonical pixels with alpha < 1
outputConstraints.opaqueNeighborPolicy: different owners must never meet across a 4-neighbor opaque edge
outputConstraints.semanticPurityPolicy: one canonical 8-connected component per owner unless semanticOwnership.componentGroupPolicy.mode is approved-same-observable-object-parts and its approvedParts exactly list every reviewed component identity for one observable object
